{{short description|British mathematics educator}}
'''Catherine Lynne McClure''' {{postnominals|country=GBR|size=100%|OBE}} (born 1952) is a British [[mathematics education|mathematics educator]]. From 2014 to 2022 she was director of Cambridge Mathematics, a program at the [[University of Cambridge]] that spans the university's mathematics and education faculties, [[University of Cambridge Local Examinations Syndicate|Cambridge Assessment]], and the [[Cambridge University Press]], and is aimed at developing a flexible tool to inform new mathematics curricula for primary and secondary mathematics education.{{r|appointed}} Between 2022 and 2024 she was Head of Mathematics Solutions within the Cambridge Partnership for Education at the University of Cambridge.

==Education and career==
McClure has a psychology degree from [[University College London]], a [[Postgraduate Certificate in Education]] from the [[University of Oxford]], and Masters degrees from both the Open University and the University of Cambridge. McClure has taught in secondary schools and as a head teacher in primary, before moving into teacher education. She became principal lecturer in education at [[Oxford Brookes University]] and then at the [[University of Edinburgh]], during which time she ran her own international education consultancy. Whilst at Cambridge, she directed the [[Millennium Mathematics Project|NRICH and Underground Maths Projects]]  before being appointed to direct Cambridge Mathematics.{{r|appointed}}

McClure was appointed [[Officer of the Order of the British Empire]] (OBE) in the [[2022 New Year Honours]] for services to education.<ref>{{London Gazette|issue=63571|supp=y|page=N13|date=1 January 2022}}</ref>

==Service==
McClure was president of the [[Mathematical Association]] for 2014–2015,{{r|ma}}
and executive chair of the [[International Society for Design and Development in Education]] for 2017–2019.{{r|isdde}} She has served twice on the [[Advisory Committee on Mathematics Education]],{{r|appointed}} and is now serving again in an ex-officio role. She was chair of the Strategic Board of the Cambridgeshire Maths Hub and is chair of the Local Governing Board of the Cambridge University [[Maths school|Maths School]]. She is a trustee of [[National Numeracy]]{{r|natnum}} and the Cambridge Philharmonic, is soon to be chair of trustees of MathsWorldUK and chairs the Education workstream of the [[Academy for the Mathematical Sciences]]. McClure is Parish Councillor for the village of Bourn.

==Publications==
* ''Meeting the needs of your most able pupils : mathematics'', 2006
* ''Maths problem solving'', 2008
